job.title: Membership Manager - NFP
job.description:
• Parramatta Location / Hybrid
  • $100-$120k + super
  • Lead a high-performing member services team and help shape the experience of a passionate membership community.

We're looking for an experienced people leader with a strong background in member services, membership organisations or the not-for-profit sector to lead a small, dedicated team delivering outstanding support to members across NSW.

This is a hands-on leadership role where you'll coach your team, improve member experiences, manage complex enquiries and complaints, and drive continuous improvement across service delivery.

If you're passionate about building relationships, leading people and creating exceptional member experiences, we'd love to hear from you.

About the Role
Reporting to the CEO, you'll be responsible for leading the Member Services function, ensuring members receive timely, professional and high-quality support.

You'll lead a small team while overseeing service standards, stakeholder engagement, CRM management, reporting and service improvement initiatives. You'll also work closely with senior leadership to identify opportunities to enhance member engagement and deliver meaningful improvements.

What You'll Be Doing
  • Lead, mentor and develop a small Member Services team.
  • Drive exceptional member service across phone, email and online channels.
  • Manage complex enquiries, complaints and stakeholder issues with professionalism and empathy.
  • Improve service processes, workflows and member experience.
  • Maintain CRM data integrity and provide meaningful reporting and insights.
  • Identify opportunities to strengthen member engagement and service offerings.
  • Partner with senior leadership to deliver operational improvements.
About You

You'll bring:
  • Experience leading a customer service, member services or stakeholder engagement team.
  • Previous experience within a membership organisation, association or not-for-profit (highly regarded).
  • Experience working within Governance 
  • Strong people leadership and coaching skills.
  • Experience managing escalated complaints and sensitive stakeholder matters.
  • Confidence using CRM systems and reporting tools.
  • A continuous improvement mindset and the ability to improve service delivery.
  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
What's on Offer
  • Salary of $100,000-$120,000 + super.
  • Lead a collaborative and values-driven team.
  • A role where your ideas and leadership will genuinely make an impact.
  • Supportive leadership and the opportunity to influence how member services are delivered.
  • Parramatta location with a collaborative working environment.

job.title: Account Manager - FMCG | Growing Business
job.description:
• $110-$120k + Super + Car Allowance
  • Career Progression to Business Manager
  • Sponsorship a possibilty for the right candidate 
The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has become available for an ambitious and commercially driven Account Manager to join a growing FMCG business.
This is an ideal opportunity for someone who understands FMCG and retail, enjoys working with independent customers and is motivated by growing sales and building strong commercial relationships.

You won't just be managing an existing portfolio. You'll have the opportunity to identify new opportunities, grow existing accounts and play an important role in the continued growth of the business.

For the right person, this role offers a genuine pathway into a Business Manager position as the business continues to expand.

About the Role

Working closely with independent retailers and key clients, you will be responsible for:
  • Managing and developing a portfolio of independent customers and key accounts
  • Building strong, long-term relationships with customers
  • Identifying opportunities to increase sales and grow existing accounts
  • Developing new business opportunities
  • Working closely with customers to understand their needs and identify commercial opportunities
  • Monitoring sales performance and achieving agreed targets
  • Providing market and customer insights to the broader business
  • Representing the brand professionally in the market
  • Taking ownership of your territory and driving results
About You

We're looking for someone who is commercially hungry, proactive and ambitious.
You will ideally have:
  • Experience in FMCG, retail, wholesale, field sales or a related environment
  • A strong understanding of retail and independent customers
  • Proven experience in account management, sales or business development
  • A strong commercial mindset with a focus on sales growth
  • Excellent relationship-building and communication skills
  • The confidence to identify opportunities and turn them into results
  • A proactive and hands-on approach
  • Strong negotiation and influencing skills
  • The ambition to take the next step in your career
Most importantly, we're looking for someone who wants to build something and grow with the business.

What's On Offer?
  • $110-$120k+ super
  • Car allowance
  • Genuine career progression into a Business Manager role
  • Opportunity to join a growing FMCG business
  • A commercially focused role with real ownership and autonomy
  • The opportunity to make a tangible impact on business growth
  • Sponsorship may be available for the right candidate
Interested?

If you're an ambitious Account Manager who understands FMCG/retail, enjoys working with independent customers and is ready to take your career to the next level, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now for a confidential conversation.

job.title: EA to CEO & Partner
job.description:
• $55-$60 + super p/hr 
  • ASAP Start until January - WHV candidates welcome to apply
  • CBD Location
Work with an impressive, entrepreneurial business at the heart of Australia's technology ecosystem. We’re looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to support a CEO & Partner in a highly respected, fast-paced and entrepreneurial business based in Sydney CBD.

This is a fantastic opportunity for an EA who enjoys working with senior leaders, thrives in a dynamic environment and wants to be part of a business that works with some of Australia's most exciting and innovative companies.
About the role You'll work closely with the CEO & Partner, providing high-level executive support and helping keep a busy schedule and priorities running smoothly.

You'll be trusted to take ownership of:
  • Complex diary and calendar management
  • Coordinating meetings with senior stakeholders, founders and business leaders
  • Travel arrangements and logistics
  • Preparing meeting materials, presentations and documents
  • Managing emails and correspondence
  • Coordinating internal and external stakeholders
  • Assisting with events, meetings and special projects
  • Following up actions and ensuring priorities stay on track
  • Ad hoc support across a genuinely varied and interesting role
This isn't a traditional, routine EA role. You'll be working in a smart, entrepreneurial environment where things move quickly and you'll have exposure to interesting people, businesses and ideas.

About you You'll ideally be an experienced EA, Executive Assistant or Senior PA who is:
  • Experienced supporting a CEO, Partner, Founder or senior executive
  • Highly organised and exceptionally detail-oriented
  • Proactive and able to anticipate what needs to happen next
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment
  • A confident and polished communicator
  • Discreet and trusted with confidential information
  • Someone who takes ownership rather than waiting to be told what to do
  • Available to start ASAP
Why this role?
  • Work closely with an influential senior leader
  • Join a genuinely interesting and entrepreneurial business
  • Be surrounded by smart, ambitious people and innovative companies
  • Sydney CBD location
  • Varied role with plenty of exposure and responsibility
  • $55–$60 per hour + super
  • ASAP start
Working Holiday Visa candidates are very welcome to apply, provided you have the appropriate working rights.

If you're an experienced EA who loves being close to the action and wants to work somewhere a little different from the traditional corporate environment, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Bid Writer / Bid Manager
job.description:
• ASX Listed Business
  • $140 - $160k + super + bonus 
  • Sydney CBD 
An exciting opportunity has become available for an experienced Bid Writer who is looking to take the next step.  Join a leading ASX-listed Australian business.

This is a key role within the organisation, responsible for managing the end-to-end bid process across a range of high-value and strategically important opportunities.

We're looking for someone who is commercially minded, highly organised and confident bringing together multiple stakeholders to deliver compelling, winning submissions.

Experience within the energy sector would be highly regarded,
particularly someone who has worked across complex tenders, infrastructure, resources or other highly regulated environments.

The Opportunity
As the Bid Manager, you will take ownership of the bid lifecycle from opportunity through to submission and handover.
Working closely with Sales, Commercial, Operations, Finance, Legal and subject matter experts, you will develop high-quality proposals that clearly demonstrate the organisation's capability and value proposition.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing end-to-end bid and tender processes
  • Developing bid strategies, response plans and submission timelines
  • Reviewing and analysing RFPs, tenders and procurement documentation
  • Coordinating internal stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Developing compelling written responses and proposal content
  • Managing bid governance, compliance and quality assurance
  • Preparing executive-level presentations and supporting materials
  • Managing multiple bids and deadlines simultaneously
  • Working closely with commercial and operational teams to ensure responses are accurate, competitive and commercially sound
  • Conducting post-bid reviews and continually improving the bid process
About You
You'll be an experienced Bid Writer, Bid Manager, Proposal Manager or Tender Manager who enjoys working in a fast-paced, commercially focused environment.

You'll bring:
  • Proven experience managing complex bids, tenders or proposals from start to finish
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
  • Strong project and stakeholder management capability
  • The ability to influence and coordinate senior stakeholders
  • Exceptional attention to detail and an ability to work to tight deadlines
  • Strong commercial acumen and the ability to understand complex business requirements
  • Confidence working across multiple functions and competing priorities
Energy sector experience would be highly desirable, along with experience across infrastructure, resources, logistics, transport, engineering or other complex B2B environments.

Most importantly, we're looking for someone with energy, drive and a genuine desire to win - someone who can take ownership, bring people together and elevate the quality of every submission.

The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to join a major Australian organisation with significant scale, complexity and growth opportunities.

You'll have the opportunity to work on high-value, strategically important bids and have genuine visibility across the broader business.

If you're an accomplished Bid Manager looking for a role where your work directly contributes to winning significant new business, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply now or contact Naomi at Pathfinder Recruitment for a confidential discussion.
